result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both pages use real beekeeping terms (queen, brood, frames, stores, queen cells) and show a 12-hive overview. A is better suited to someone standing at a hive: it has larger radio tap targets and marks fields as optional, while B uses smaller pill buttons and adds extra air-temperature and conditions fields. Neither screenshot shows the empty log area or the save confirmation, so items 2 and 3 are only partly judged. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both pages use beekeeping terms throughout (hive, queen, brood, frames, stores) and stay a single inspection log for the 12 hives. B suits someone standing at a hive a little better: its radio buttons are larger, optional fields are labelled, and it notes that entries are saved on the device. A has a good set of brood and queen-cell chips, but the chips are smaller and it adds air temp and conditions fields. Neither screenshot shows the empty log area or a save confirmation, so I scored items 2 and 3 only from what is visible.
